# Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` for this repository.

This repo must stay public-safe. Do not rely on private repo context being available to readers, workers, downstream AI systems, or other agents.

Keep instructions portable across local clones, cloud workspaces, and other agents. Do not add private operations, protected endpoint details, billing/provider tactics, or required references to one PC's filesystem. Use repo-relative paths for local files and public URLs for source records.
